value.rationale: Reducing the unnormalized classical equation mod two would lose the entire quartic relation. The primitive flat closure instead has a sharply nonreduced special fibre, distinct from the existing modular inseparable-cover model. The complete behavior of every distinguished singular-line limit as all rational generators and the resultant point-free natural open threefold are structurally motivated boundary information, not an arbitrary parameter slice; the classical incidence itself is credited, not claimed novel.
